# fw cluster

> Reference of the fw cluster command: Inference router (KV-cache affinity, prefill/decode split) over the sample topology, or a Kubernetes cluster through…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/cluster/

Inference router (KV-cache affinity, prefill/decode split) over the sample topology, or a Kubernetes cluster through kube-rs (runs fw-k8s)

## Usage

```bash
fw cluster [summary|route <prompt>|k8s <status|nodes|pods|apply -f FILE|topology>]
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw cluster summary
fw cluster route
fw cluster k8s
```

The names come from the usage line.
